description: Belgian calibration and validation schema groundwork, by reference only. Values and source projections would resolve from Chronicle consumer facts at build time, but the current Chronicle Belgian catalog does not satisfy this full selector and period surface. Criticality tiers, relative tolerances, and target_role are validated declaration metadata only: this package does not yet wire them into runtime calibration objectives or release gates. Multi-cell series remain non-executable until Chronicle fanout produces cell-pinned references. The GRAPA and Flemish child-recipient rows are validation-only declarations whose Microcosm population inputs and PolicyEngine behavior/input support are absent. The Brussels entitled-child row is a distinct legal-rights anchor whose document-grounded Axiom output is absent; it is not behavior owned by PolicyEngine. Both regional source facts also require an explicit NUTS1-vintage projection before they can satisfy the typed selectors. These rows do not form a national child-benefit sum, do not combine child and family/payee entities, and do not declare behavioral take-up concepts in Axiom. German-speaking Community and French-language Wallonia facts remain outside this target surface until typed administrative geography support exists. No external-oracle implementation from #264 is included. The file never copies a target value from Chronicle, a survey publication, or a validation oracle.

target_references.name: statbel_population_by_age_sex_region

metadata.series: Structure of the population: age band by sex by region

target_references.notes: Non-executable series placeholder for an age-band x sex x NUTS1 count surface. Chronicle must fan this into dimension- and geography-pinned scalar references before compilation. The selector uses the typed NUTS1-2025 authority alias; a differently-vintaged source requires an explicit Chronicle projection/crosswalk. An observation for another year may enter only as a Chronicle source_projection whose fact period is the declared 2023 reference year.

target_references.name: statbel_fiscal_income_by_commune

metadata.series: Fiscal statistics of income: total net taxable income by municipality

target_references.notes: Non-executable series placeholder for commune fiscal-income cells; Chronicle must fan it into one commune-pinned scalar reference per selected cell before compilation. The eventual open commune series is diagnostic until the synthetic spine demonstrates adequate support. The selector binds the typed nis_2025 alias to the spine's 2025 NIS code set, and another code set must be projected and crosswalked in Chronicle rather than partially joined.

target_references.name: spf_finances_pit_total
target_references.notes: National assessed PIT is compared with the Axiom-computed federal and local liability on the 2022 income-year basis. Assessment-year facts must identify the represented income year in Chronicle; a period mismatch is a projection, never a silent relabeling.

target_references.name: onss_employee_contribution_total
target_references.notes: Worker-side contributions on the encoded slice. Employer-side and capped-regime totals can enter as distinct references when both the engine concepts and Ledger selectors exist.

target_references.name: onem_unemployment_caseload
target_references.notes: The initial caseload family declares the calendar-year recipient count, not a behavioral take-up rate. It remains non-executable because PolicyEngine-owned unemployment receipt/behavior input support and an exact period mapping are absent; no Axiom take-up, propensity, elasticity, or latent-draw concept is declared or implied. Pension and regional child-benefit caseload references can join this family only when their Chronicle packages, typed geographies, and distinct model mappings land.

target_references.name: sfpd_grapa_regular_payment_beneficiaries_2025_01

metadata.series: GRAPA beneficiaries in the January 2025 regular-payment population

target_references.notes: Validation-only declaration for the SFPD January 2025 regular-payment population. This is a point-in-time payment-recipient snapshot, not an eligibility denominator, annual caseload, transaction count, or behavioral take-up rate; an unresolved same-date PensionStat total also makes it unsuitable as a silent release-blocking target. PolicyEngine must own and supply a distinct receipt/behavior input before Microcosm can estimate this row. A positive Axiom entitlement or payment amount is not an observed receipt flag, and no Axiom take-up, propensity, elasticity, or latent-draw concept is declared or implied.

target_references.name: opgroeien_basic_amount_child_recipients_2025_12

metadata.series: Children receiving the Groeipakket basic amount in December 2025

target_references.notes: Validation-only declaration for provisional December 2025 children receiving the Groeipakket basic amount in the Flemish Region. December 2025 is the publisher's rights month, not a payment-execution month. This is a child-recipient count, not a family/payee count, eligibility denominator, or behavioral take-up rate. Microcosm population support for the distinct recipient input and PolicyEngine behavior/input support are absent. The Chronicle source fact identifies BE2 under NUTS_2024 while the Belgian typed Microcosm registry binds NUTS1 to 2025; the stable region code is not enough to relabel the source, so an explicit Chronicle source projection must precede activation. No Axiom take-up or behavioral concept is declared or implied.

target_references.name: iriscare_child_benefit_entitled_children_2025_12

metadata.series: Children entitled to child benefit in Brussels in December 2025

target_references.notes: Validation-only declaration for provisional December 2025 children entitled to child benefit in Brussels. Entitlement is a legal-rights anchor, not observed receipt, the separately published payment-recipient count, or behavioral take-up. Activation requires an Axiom entitlement output whose concept and rule are each grounded in cited public-policy documents; PolicyEngine does not own this legal concept. This row deliberately uses a different intended measure from the Flemish child-recipient count. The Chronicle source fact identifies BE1 under NUTS_2024 while the typed Microcosm selector binds NUTS1 to 2025, so activation also requires an explicit source projection. No Axiom take-up or behavioral concept is declared or implied.

target_references.name: nbb_household_disposable_income
target_references.notes: Validation-tier level anchor only. The macro-realism gate may use it as a broad band, but neither the exact NBB level nor any survey- or EUROMOD-derived quantity enters the calibration objective.

child_benefit_rights_month_2025_12.description: Child-level basic-amount recipient population published for the December 2025 rights month; this does not assert a payment-execution month.

child_benefit_entitlement_month_2025_12.description: Child-level entitlement population observed for December 2025, distinct from receipt or payee counts.
